sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 233771 (per-site catalog)

values.note: $18 a night, including one vehicle; $9 each additional vehicle (paid to the host on arrival); $6 day-use fee over half an hour.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cascade-campground ('Single Site: $18 per night', '$18.00 includes 1 driving vehicle', '$9 each additional vehicle', '$6 day use campground fee for over ½ hour') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233771/rates (2026 Peak Season 06-05 to 09-10 and First-come, First-served seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 18), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cascade-campground ('1/2 price fees for Interagency Senior or Access Pass holders'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233771 (all 29 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 30 sites, a mix of reservable and first-come. recreation.gov lists 29 with lengths of 18-40 ft (ten at 30, one at 40; six under 23 ft).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cascade-campground ('Camp sites: 30, a mix of reservable and first come first serve sites', 'Max Trailer Length : 40 feet') + recreation.gov catalog for 233771 (Max Vehicle Length 18-40), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water by hand pump. No trash here: the dumpster is at Basin Campground. Firewood from the host. The FS page's amenity block says 'Potable water is not available at this site. No potable water- campers can get water from Cascade campground', which contradicts its own description and recreation.gov.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233771 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. Trash may be deposited in receptacles at nearby Basin Campground'; amenity 'Drinking Water (hand pump)') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cascade-campground (same description; 'Trash Pickup: Dumpster located at Basin Campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Mix of reservable and first-come sites (recreation.gov: 24 reservable, 5 not); first-come sites are taken in person only ('DO NOT call to determine availability'), and the spring and fall shoulder nights are first-come. 16 days maximum in Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds. A reserved site is held 24 hours past check-in time.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cascade-campground ('a mix of reservable and first come first serve sites', 'There is a 16 day maximum stay in all Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233771 (notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', late-arrival policy; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16) + catalog (24 reservable, 5 not), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS (Custer Gallatin NF, Beartooth Ranger District) campground along West Fork Rock Creek, ~10.4 mi up West Fork Road (FR 2071) from Red Lodge; the last ~3 mi past the end of pavement are dirt. Burned in the 2008 Cascade Fire but some trees remain in the campground. Concession-run by Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $18 (2026; +$9 extra vehicle), 30 sites with 40-ft max trailer, vault toilets, no electric, reservable on recreation.gov with some first-come sites (platform was inherited). Added season mid-June to Labor Day (FS) with recreation.gov's first-come shoulder nights noted, drinking water (hand pump), 16-night limit, the senior/access half-price discount for this campground, concessionaire RRMA. Not stated: booking window (180 inherited left). Note trimmed and corrected (road is dirt for the last ~3 mi, not 'mostly paved'). Season left unwritten: FS (Mid-June-Labor Day) and rec.gov (FCFS nights 05-01..09-20) conflict.
flags: Missing phone: the Forest Service page names the concessionaire Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA), (928) 537-8888; Beartooth District Office (406) 446-2103.

Season conflict: Forest Service 'Mid-June through Labor Day' vs recreation.gov first-come seasons 2026-05-01 to 06-04 and 09-11 to 09-20 (a rate season is not a campground season, so the FS statement was written).

Forest Service page contradicts itself on drinking water (description: 'drinking water are provided'; amenity block: 'Potable water is not available ... campers can get water from Cascade campground', apparently copied from a neighbouring campground's page).
